Each language value is [meaning, method, basis]. scope UNIFIED = a UNIFIED_WORDS sense; DATASET = a sense that only an [어휘] source list (VOCAB_GROUPS, VOCAB_CHAIN, ...) has. zh_cn_by_zh gives the Simplified form of each Traditional zh text of those lists, so a record gets the conversion of its own zh. Only missing languages are filled; existing meanings are never replaced. See word_meaning_translation/README.txt.
